CLARKE OUTDOOR SPRAYING COMPANY, Inc.
MOSQUITO CONTROL - AQUATIC WEED CONTROL
INSPECTION . LARVICIDING . FOGGING . MISTING
200 HAYES AVENUE
LA GRANGE, ILLINOIS 60525
January 10, 1972
Mr. Daniel S. Tankersley Prosecuting Attorney Monticello Street Winamac, Indiana 46996
Dear Mr. Tankersley:
Enclosed is a revised proposal which provides for a helicopter inspection to evaluate results of the program.
I spent the day driving over typical growing areas with representatives of the Indiana State Department of Conservation and the Purdue University Extention Service. Consensus was that no wildlife would be killed by direct application but that perhaps the broad leaf plants which would be eliminated would decrease the food available to wildlife. No one seemed terribly alarmed about the program.
I would be happy to meet with your local farmers when ever this is convient for you.
Very truly yours,
CLARKE OUTDOOR SPRAYING CO., INC.
John L. Clarke, Jr.
Vice President
